name: everything
says: Every holon in the field.

name: type
says: The instances of the types given.

name: children
says: What the holons given hold, as parts.

name: parents
says: What holds the holons given.

name: points
says: What the holons given point at, without holding.

name: pointers
says: What points at the holons given, without holding.

name: search
says: What contains each of the words given.

name: named
says: What is called by each of the words given.

name: store
says: What the store given holds.

name: types
says: Every type.

name: stores
says: The keys of the stores the field is, each a string, as store is given one.

name: and
says: Of sets of holons, what every one holds; of truths, whether all are true, read no further than the first that is not.

name: or
says: Of sets of holons, what any one holds; of truths, the first that is true, read no further.

name: not
says: Of a set of holons, everything but it; of a truth, its opposite.

name: group
says: The set given, in collections along the axis chosen: type, parent or store.

name: flat
says: All of the set given, looked at as it is, where a set is otherwise seen at its level: what nothing in it holds.

name: in
says: The references into the holon given: each from where, under what key, and whether it holds.

name: out
says: The references out of the holon given, in the order its body holds them, what it is an instance of first: each to where, under what key, and whether it holds.

name: says
says: What may be said of the holon given as text: its name and its own strings, lower case.

name: log
says: The commits of the store whose key is given, each when, what it says, and its hash.

name: get
says: What the value given holds under the key: a holon's id, name, store, instance, mould or any field of its body; a record's field; a list's place.

name: keys
says: The keys of a record, or of a holon's body.

name: kind
says: What kind of value is given: null, boolean, number, string, list, record, holon or function.

name: follow
says: A walk from the holons given, each step a function from a holon to where it goes, until nothing new is reached, or the depth or the until a third record says: the edges walked, each from, to, key and depth.

name: map
says: Each of the list given, given to the function.

name: filter
says: What of the list given the function finds true.

name: fold
says: The list given folded into one value, from the start, by a function of what is folded so far and the next.

name: sort
says: The list given in order, by what the function gives for each, or by itself.

name: reverse
says: The list given, last first.

name: take
says: The first of the list given, as many as the number.

name: apply
says: The function given, given what follows it.

name: skip
says: The list given without its first, as many as the number.

name: first
says: The first of the list given.

name: last
says: The last of the list given.

name: size
says: How many the list given holds.

name: has
says: Whether the list given holds the value.

name: distinct
says: The list given, each value once, where it first stands.

name: concat
says: The lists given, one after another.

name: minus
says: The first list given without what the second holds.

name: put
says: The record given, with the key set to the value.

name: else
says: The value given, or where it is null, the other.

name: eq
says: Whether the two values given are the same.

name: lt
says: Whether the first value given comes before the second, both of one kind.

name: add
says: The two numbers given, added.

name: mul
says: The two numbers given, multiplied.

name: round
says: The number given, to the nearest whole.

name: join
says: The strings of the list given, one after another, with what is given between them; what is null is left out.

name: words
says: The words of the text given, lower case.

name: contains
says: Whether the text given holds every word of the other.

name: if
says: The second value given, if the first is true, else the third; only what is chosen is worked out.

name: case
says: The value of the record given under the key the first gives, else the third; only what is chosen is worked out.

name: parts
says: What a holon holds, in the order it is read: a brief's flow, then its sections; anything else in the order its body holds it.

name: text
says: A holon's prose as text, the whole of it: a word as written, a sentence its words, a whole its heading, its own words, and what it holds. The number, if given, is the depth its first heading stands at.

name: measure
says: A holon, or a run of them, measured in tokens, as a reader takes it whole: the words beneath it and those kept as strings, each holon once, at about 1.85 tokens to a word.

name: digest
says: A holon cut into pieces a reader can take at once, in the order it is read: itself if it fits the budget of tokens, else what it holds, cut in turn, side by side packed into runs while they fit.

name: level
says: A set seen at its level: what nothing in it holds. The roots of a store are its level.

name: is
says: Whether a holon is an instance of the type given.

name: outline
says: A holon's structure without its prose, to a depth: each named whole, its measure in tokens, and what it holds beneath; below the depth, how many it holds.
